description: This Java source file defines an immutable builder class 'ImmutableFeatureFromCopyBuilder' that provides a fluent API for constructing 'Feature' objects from existing features or property data. It implements the 'FeatureBuilder' and 'FeatureBuilder.FromCopyBuildable' interfaces, allowing modification and creation of feature instances with specific properties and identifiers.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureFromCopyBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating immutable 'Feature' objects, initialized from an existing 'Feature' and allowing setting of properties, definition, and feature ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an 'ImmutableFeatureFromCopyBuilder' initialized with an existing 'Feature' object.

methods.name: definition
methods.description: Sets the feature definition in the builder.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Sets the properties in the builder, either from a 'FeatureProperties' object or a 'JsonObject'.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Transforms existing properties using a provided function.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the feature ID if the existing ID satisfies the provided predicate.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an immutable 'Feature' object based on current builder state.
